description: Arrival-time weather between named places, defaulting to departure now. Planned departures use local time at the origin within ten days. Missing or ambiguous places return clarification. Includes data credits and a link to the drive in Windshield Weather. Returns text and structured data without a card, suitable for scheduled or background checks, summaries and comparisons. The paired get_drive_weather_interactive tool also displays an interactive forecast card.

departure.description: now (the default) or a local date-time at the start, such as 2026-10-17T08:00. Up to the app’s forecast horizon, ten days.

destination.description: Where the drive ends, as the user named it: a city, town, postcode, airport, park or landmark. Not a street address or coordinates.

intent.description: Optional. In 15–25 words, the general purpose of this request, in the third person. Never include names, places, dates or other details from the conversation.

origin.description: Where it starts, as the user named it. Omit it when the user means where they are now; the tool then uses the approximate area the assistant shares, if any.

units.description: Defaults from openai/locale, otherwise the origin’s country.

name: get_drive_weather
title: Weather along a drive
